summary.text: 2017年6月，Google Brain的八位研究员（Ashish Vaswani等人）发表了题为《Attention Is All You Need》的划时代论文。这篇论文提出了“Transformer”架构，彻底抛弃了当时主流的循环神经网络（RNN）和卷积神经网络（CNN），完全依赖“自注意力机制”（Self-Attention）来处理序列数据。Transformer的最大突破在于它支持并行计算（不再需要像RNN那样按顺序读入单词），这使得在海量数据上训练超大规模模型成为可能。它是GPT、BERT以及今天所有生成式AI（包括ChatGPT）的共同祖先。
summary.text_en: In June 2017, eight researchers at Google Brain (Ashish Vaswani et al.) published the epoch-making paper 'Attention Is All You Need'. This paper introduced the 'Transformer' architecture, completely discarding the then-dominant Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in favor of 'Self-Attention' mechanisms. The biggest breakthrough of the Transformer was that it allowed for parallel computation (no longer needing to process words sequentially like RNNs), making it possible to train massive models on enormous datasets. It is the common ancestor of GPT, BERT, and all modern Generative AI (including ChatGPT).
key_points: 提出了自注意力机制 (Self-Attention)，解决了长距离依赖问题
抛弃了循环 (Recurrence)，实现了训练的高度并行化
引入了多头注意力 (Multi-Head Attention) 和位置编码 (Positional Encoding)
最初只是为了改进机器翻译任务（英德翻译）
这篇论文的8位作者后来被称为“AI黑手党”，几乎全都离职创立了顶级AI公司
key_points_en: Proposed Self-Attention, solving the long-term dependency problem
Discarded Recurrence, enabling highly parallelized training
Introduced Multi-Head Attention and Positional Encoding
Originally designed just to improve Machine Translation (English-German)
The 8 authors, later known as the 'Transformer Mafia', almost all left to found top AI startups

story.text: Transformer的故事充满了传奇色彩。论文的标题《Attention Is All You Need》其实是作者Llion Jones受披头士歌曲《All You Need Is Love》启发起的。当时，团队正在苦恼于LSTM（长短期记忆网络）在大规模训练上的龟速。Ashish Vaswani和Jakob Uszkoreit等人突发奇想：如果我们完全不要RNN的循环结构，只保留“注意力”会怎样？Noam Shazeer则不仅提供了关键的理论支持，还亲手写下了最高效的TensorFlow代码。虽然他们当时只想把翻译搞好，但这篇论文实际上无意中开启了“大模型时代”。如今，这篇论文已被引用超过10万次，是深度学习历史上最重要的文献之一。
story.text_en: The story of the Transformer is legendary. The title 'Attention Is All You Need' was actually suggested by author Llion Jones, inspired by the Beatles song 'All You Need Is Love'. At the time, the team was frustrated by the snail's pace of training LSTMs (Long Short-Term Memory) at scale. Ashish Vaswani, Jakob Uszkoreit, and others had a wild idea: what if we completely ditched the recurrent structure of RNNs and kept only 'Attention'? Noam Shazeer not only provided key theoretical support but also hand-wrote the most efficient TensorFlow code. Although they just wanted to improve translation at the time, this paper inadvertently launched the 'Era of Large Models'. Today, it has been cited over 100,000 times, making it one of the most important documents in deep learning history.

fun_facts.text: 这就是传说中的“Transformer八子”。这8位作者后来全部离开了Google，创立了Cohere、Character.ai、Adept、Near、Inceptive等独角兽公司，估值总和超过数百亿美元。
fun_facts.text_en: This is the legendary 'Transformer Eight'. All 8 authors eventually left Google to found unicorn startups like Cohere, Character.ai, Adept, Near, and Inceptive, with a combined valuation of tens of billions.

fun_facts.text: Paper中著名的Transformer架构图（那个高高的灰盒子）并不是设计师画的，而是作者之一Ashish Vaswani自己在PowerPoint里随手画的，结果成了AI史上最经典的图标。
fun_facts.text_en: The famous Transformer architecture diagram in the paper (that tall grey box) wasn't drawn by a designer, but sketched by Ashish Vaswani himself in PowerPoint. It ended up becoming the most classic icon in AI history.

simple_explanation.text:
以前的AI（RNN）读句子像小学生：一个字一个字读，读到句尾时，可能已经忘了句首说了什么（长距离遗忘）。
Transformer像速读大师：它一眼就能同时看到整篇文章（并行处理），并且能瞬间知道“苹果”这个词在句子A里是指水果，在句子B里是指手机（通过自注意力机制捕捉上下文）。
simple_explanation.text_en:
Previous AI (RNN) read sentences like a primary school student: word by word. By the time it reached the end, it might have forgotten the beginning (long-term forgetting).
Transformer is like a speed-reading master: it sees the whole article at once (parallel processing) and instantly knows that 'Apple' in Sentence A means fruit and in Sentence B means a phone (context via self-attention).

applications.title: BERT & GPT
applications.text: Transformer分化出了两个流派：Google走了Encoder路线做出了BERT（擅长理解），OpenAI走了Decoder路线做出了GPT（擅长生成）。
applications.text_en: Transformer split into two schools: Google took the Encoder route to create BERT (good at understanding), OpenAI took the Decoder route to create GPT (good at generation).

applications.title: AlphaFold 2
applications.text: Transformer不仅能处理语言，还能处理任何序列。AlphaFold 2就是用Transformer极其变体来处理氨基酸序列，预测蛋白质结构的。
applications.text_en: Transformer handles not just language, but any sequence. AlphaFold 2 used Transformer variants to process amino acid sequences and predict protein structures.

impact.text: Transformer是AI领域的“工业革命”。它统一了NLP（自然语言处理）甚至CV（计算机视觉）的架构。有了它，只要使劲堆显卡、堆数据，模型就会越来越聪明（Scaling Laws）。它结束了不同AI任务需要不同模型的碎片化时代，开启了“基础模型”（Foundation Models）的大一统时代。
impact.text_en: Transformer was the 'Industrial Revolution' of AI. It unified the architectures of NLP and even CV. With it, you just need to pile on GPUs and data, and the model gets smarter (Scaling Laws). It ended the fragmented era where different AI tasks needed different models, ushering in the unified era of 'Foundation Models'.

influenced_by.contribution: Seq2Seq（Ilya Sutskever提出的序列到序列框架是Transformer想要优化的直接对象）
influenced_by.contribution_en: Seq2Seq (The Sequence-to-Sequence framework proposed by Ilya Sutskever was the direct object Transformer aimed to optimize)

influenced_by.contribution: 注意力机制（Bahdanau等人早在2014年就提出了注意力机制，但只是把它作为RNN的辅助工具，Transformer则将其“扶正”为核心）
influenced_by.contribution_en: Attention Mechanism (Bahdanau et al. proposed Attention in 2014, but only as a helper to RNNs; Transformer promoted it to the core)

influenced.contribution: BERT（Google基于Transformer的双向编码器，横扫了当年的NLP榜单）
influenced.contribution_en: BERT (Google's bidirectional encoder based on Transformer, which swept the NLP leaderboards that year)

influenced.contribution: ChatGPT（GPT中的'T'就是Transformer。没有Transformer，就没有生成式AI的爆发）
influenced.contribution_en: ChatGPT (The 'T' in GPT stands for Transformer. Without Transformer, there would be no Generative AI explosion)

influence_chain.legacy_text: 它告诉世界：你不需要循环，只需要关注。
influence_chain.legacy_text_en: It told the world: You don't need recurrence, just attention.

quiz.question: Transformer相比于传统的RNN（循环神经网络），最大的优势是什么？
quiz.question_en: What is the biggest advantage of Transformer compared to traditional RNNs?
options: 可以并行计算，大幅缩短训练时间，并更好地捕捉长距离依赖
options_en: Parallel computation, drastically reducing training time, and better capturing long-range dependencies
quiz.explanation: RNN必须等读完第一个词才能读第二个词（串行），无法利用GPU并行加速，且容易忘事。Transformer可以同时读入所有词（并行），既快又能看到全局。
quiz.explanation_en: RNNs must read the first word before the second (serial), unable to utilize GPU parallelism, and are prone to forgetting. Transformer reads all words simultaneously (parallel), which is faster and allows global context.
